targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.total_ms)) AS value FROM turns t JOIN calls c ON c.id=t.call_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND t.role='agent' AND t.total_ms>0
SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.total_ms)) AS value FROM turns t JOIN calls c ON c.id=t.call_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND t.role='agent' AND t.total_ms>0
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE end_reason='transferred') / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) AS value FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND limit_hit IS NOT NULL

SELECT $__timeGroup(c.started_at, '5m') AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.total_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.total_ms) AS p95 FROM turns t JOIN calls c ON c.id=t.call_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND t.role='agent' AND t.total_ms>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Where the time goes
panels.description: eou includes stt. A rise in eou is our machine; a rise in llm/tts is the provider.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(c.started_at, '5m') AS time, avg(t.eou_ms) AS eou, avg(t.llm_ttft_ms) AS llm_ttft, avg(t.tts_ttfb_ms) AS tts_ttfb FROM turns t JOIN calls c ON c.id=t.call_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND t.role='agent' AND t.total_ms>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(started_at, '10m') AS time, count(*) AS calls FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT coalesce(end_reason,'unknown') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: LLM tokens
panels.description: Cached tokens are billed at a lower rate. The KB rides on every request, so prompt tokens dominate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(started_at, '30m') AS time, sum(llm_prompt_tokens - coalesce(llm_prompt_cached_tokens,0)) AS prompt_uncached, sum(llm_prompt_cached_tokens) AS prompt_cached, sum(llm_completion_tokens) AS completion FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT id, started_at, caller, round(duration_ms/1000.0,1) AS secs, turn_count AS turns, end_reason, limit_hit, transferred_to, llm_prompt_tokens AS prompt_tok, llm_completion_tokens AS compl_tok, tts_characters AS tts_chars FROM calls WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
